items.p: Walk an active build from any angle, and pause it at footings, frame, lock-up or fit-out.
Sequencing, structure and trade detail, encoded by the educators who teach it — not generic 3D.
Zero site risk. No PPE or inductions — replay any stage as many times as it takes.
Runs on the Windows & macOS laptops students already own. No headset required.
Interactive and rewarding — learning that feels like play, not a lecture.
Tune to any skill level, from first-years to final-year cohorts.
